answers.core: Changes need to be done in gridmap.cpp. It is a logical extension to make MultiMesh's flexibilities available for GridMap.
answers.workaround: No, there is no script workaround. A workaround is to duplicate each Item in the MeshLib once for each color or custom data you want to use. The number of duplicated items could be excessive.

title: Extend GridMap Cells with a custom Color and custom Data property as in underlying MultiMesh
